title: 22 升级23 内卷24 对练
slug: 我有装备栏460上次那一位
content_zh:
;;
赤火武馆。
在月底最后一天，又有一名学徒心态崩了，自行退出。
但与此同时，韩饷一举登顶，气血如虹！
他是第三个做到气血大成的学徒。
除了韩饷，严流影、田晨羽、吴采薇三人也临近突破。
以上四个人都是家境优渥，可以每天获得充足的滋补，而且根骨天赋也不错的学徒。
其他人的进展，马马虎虎。
他们要么出身普通，要么自身天赋不足，更有甚者，普通又没才华。
搬血法第一关重在蓄养气血，关键在于滋补，次在领悟修炼。
没钱或者没才华的人，只能花费更多的时间慢慢熬。
“是时候了。”
齐知玄决定突破。
人们往往只会记住第一名，偶尔会提起第二名和第三名。
没有人在意第四名是谁。
于是。
就在这天夜里。
黑暗的宿舍里，齐知玄缓缓吐出一口浊气，体内气血犹如江河决堤一般宣泄而出。
他的肌肤迅速发红发烫，逸散出红光，红光熠熠，越来越浓烈炫灿，恍若火苗在体表窜动，呼呼燃烧，驱散了黑暗。
一时间。

满室红光，好似失火！
【赤火搬血法第一层：大成】
【获得称号：气血武者】
【装备栏+1】
【当前装备栏数量：2格】
【可用装备栏：2格。】
【装备效果：根据物品的特质强化或减弱宿主的个人属性。】
【装备方式：身体接触。】
……
面板一阵模糊，装备栏格子一分为二。
“两个装备栏！！”
齐知玄眼底一亮，简直喜出望外。
他早就觉得一个装备栏不够用。
“看来只要我提升武学境界，装备栏的数量也会随之增加。”
content_en:
;;
Red Fire Martial Arts School.
On the last day of the month, another apprentice lost his temper and quit on his own.
But at the same time, Han Rong reached the top in one fell swoop, and his energy and blood were like a rainbow!
He is the third apprentice to achieve great success in Qi and Blood.
In addition to Han Rong, Yan Liuying, Tian Chenyu, and Wu Caiwei are also on the verge of breakthrough.
The above four people are all apprentices from well-off families, able to get sufficient nourishment every day, and also have good talent.
The progress of others was so-so.
They are either from ordinary backgrounds, or they lack talent, or even worse, they are ordinary and have no talent.
The first step of the blood removal method is to accumulate qi and blood. The key is nourishment, and the second step is to understand and practice.
People who have no money or talent can only spend more time and slowly suffer.
"It's time."
Qi Zhixuan decided to break through.
People tend to only remember the first place, and occasionally mention the second and third places.
No one cares who comes in fourth.
then.
Just this night.
In the dark dormitory, Qi Zhixuan slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air, and the energy and blood in his body burst out like a river bursting its banks.
His skin quickly turned red and hot, emitting red light. The red light shone, becoming more and more intense and dazzling, as if fire was running on the surface of his body, burning and dispelling the darkness.
For a while.
The room was filled with red light, as if there was a fire!
[The first level of red fire blood removal method: Dacheng]
[Obtained the title: Qi and Blood Warrior]
[Equipment Column +1]
[Current number of equipment slots: 2 spaces]
[Available equipment slot: 2 spaces. 】
[Equipment effect: Strengthen or weaken the host's personal attributes according to the characteristics of the item. 】
[Equipment method: physical contact. 】
…
The panel blurred for a while, and the equipment column grid was divided into two.
"Two equipment slots!!"
Qi Zhixuan's eyes lit up and he was simply overjoyed.
He had long felt that one equipment slot was not enough.
"It seems that as long as I improve my martial arts level, the number of equipment slots will also increase."
